# Better Mapandan

> An independent, citizen-maintained civic transparency portal for the Municipality of Mapandan, Pangasinan, Philippines. Providing open access to government services, officials, ordinances, budgets, and community information. Part of the BetterGov.ph initiative.

> Trilingual (315 pages): English at https://bettermapandan.org/, Filipino at https://bettermapandan.org/fil/, Pangasinan at https://bettermapandan.org/pag/. Language switcher: EN / FIL / PANG.

## Quick Facts
- Municipality: Mapandan, Pangasinan (Third District)
- Population: 38,228 (2024 PSA estimate)
- Barangays: 15
- Land Area: 32.92 km²
- CY 2026 Budget: ₱218.2M (General Appropriations)
- COA Audit Opinion 2023: Unqualified (Clean)
- COA Audit Opinion 2024: Qualified
- Website: https://bettermapandan.org

## Key Officials
- Mayor: Hon. Karl Christian F. Vega (Nacionalista Party)
- Vice Mayor: Hon. Anthony C. Penuliar (Independent)
- 8 Sangguniang Bayan members + 2 ex-officio (Liga ng mga Barangay, SK Federation)

## Services
- [Services Directory](https://bettermapandan.org/services/): Browse all 86 municipal services across 13 categories, with requirements, procedures, fees, and office contacts. Also in Filipino (/fil/services/) and Pangasinan (/pag/services/).
- [Business Permits](https://bettermapandan.org/services/business-permit/): New and renewal business permitting.
- [Civil Registry](https://bettermapandan.org/services/birth-certificate/): Birth, marriage, death certificates and corrections.
- [Health Services](https://bettermapandan.org/services/health-consultation/): Consultations, permits, and public health programs.
- [Social Welfare](https://bettermapandan.org/services/senior-pwd-id/): Senior Citizen, PWD, and solo parent IDs.
- [Real Property Tax](https://bettermapandan.org/services/rpt-payment/): RPT payment and tax clearance.
- [Building Permit](https://bettermapandan.org/services/building-permit/): Construction and occupancy permits.
- [Zoning Clearance](https://bettermapandan.org/services/zoning-clearance/): Land use and zoning clearance.
- [Agriculture Subsidy](https://bettermapandan.org/services/agriculture-subsidy/): Seeds, fertilizers, and farm input distribution.

## Government
- [Government Officials](https://bettermapandan.org/government/): Mayor, Vice Mayor, Sanggunian members, and department contacts.
- [Barangays](https://bettermapandan.org/government/#barangays): All 15 barangays with officials, population, and history.
- [Emergency Hotlines](https://bettermapandan.org/government/#emergency): MDRRMO, BFP, PNP contact numbers.

## Transparency & Budget
- [Transparency](https://bettermapandan.org/transparency/): Hub linking 4 subpages (below).
- [Procurement](https://bettermapandan.org/transparency/procurement/): 277 PhilGEPS contracts with monthly trends, top awardees, and full tables.
- [Infrastructure](https://bettermapandan.org/transparency/infrastructure/): 40 DPWH projects with interactive map and status tracking.
- [Budget & Fiscal](https://bettermapandan.org/transparency/budget-fiscal/): ₱218.2M CY 2026 budget, revenue breakdowns, FDP dashboard and DILG filings.
- [Audit & Compliance](https://bettermapandan.org/transparency/audit-compliance/): COA opinions, findings, implementation rates, 12-year report archive.
- [Legislative](https://bettermapandan.org/legislative/): 26 ordinances, 18 resolutions, 7 executive issuances, and fiscal data.
- [Statistics](https://bettermapandan.org/statistics/): Population, demographics, and development indicators.

## Site navigation
- Long-form pages share a section nav: sticky desktop sidebar (scrollspy, collapsible groups) and a mobile press-and-hold edge menu.
- Transparency subpages share pill tabs on desktop and a native-select bar on mobile.

## Audit Data (COA Annual Audit Reports 2014–2025)
- Total Assets: ₱555.4M (CY 2024)
- Government Equity: ₱444.7M (CY 2024)
- CY 2024 Revenue: ₱173.8M (COA AAR)
- CY 2024 Expenses: ₱183.6M (COA AAR)
- 12-Year Audit Opinion: 2 Unqualified, 9 Qualified, 1 Non-Compliant (LDRRMF)
- Outstanding Disallowances: ₱35,187 (persistent since 2018)

## Key Barangays
Amanoaoac, Apaya, Aserda, Baloling, Coral, Golden, Jimenez, Lambayan, Luyan (Luyan South), Nilombot, Pias, Poblacion, Primicias, Sta. Maria (Luyan North), Torres.

## Support
- [Accessibility](https://bettermapandan.org/support/accessibility/): Accessibility features and assistive technology support.
- [FAQ](https://bettermapandan.org/support/faq/): Frequently asked questions about using the portal.
- [Report Errors](https://bettermapandan.org/support/report/): Report incorrect information or suggest updates.
- [Privacy Policy](https://bettermapandan.org/support/privacy/): Data privacy and terms of use.

## About
- [About Better Mapandan](https://bettermapandan.org/about/): Project mission, history of Mapandan, and civic tech initiative.
- [Contact](https://bettermapandan.org/government/): Municipal contacts and department directories.
